scope: Independent source-only review of all 31 electronic recipe blocks and six inventory lists; no other observer annotations or targets. Loci below are a full bounded review catalogue, not a claim to have exhaustively solved Latin syntax.
decision: A complete exact literal token stream with finite local annotation alternatives is feasible. A unique complete ingredient/operation/reference semantic graph is not established. Freeze literal provenance first; do not present ambiguous annotations as independently observed semantics.
segmentation: 31 Harsch h4 recipe blocks with hidden Alias paragraph retained in I; XXI/XXII qualified by independent edition receipt. Six inventory lists are units; the final storage instruction is a separately retained non-list coda, never silently discarded. Titles, inventory headings and recipe contents retain separate provenance.

policy.token_identity: Every original word occurrence survives exactly once, in original order, with original case, spelling and source span. Tags decorate spans; they do not replace or expand words. Punctuation and editorial marks retained separately. No lemmatization or botanical identification needed for literal equality.
policy.unknown_identity: folium is a literal lexical item with UNRESOLVED referent. Finite alternatives: bare ingredient/name versus generic part without expressed possessor. No bay-leaf or other botanical identity is invented. Identical spelling need not establish identical referent.
policy.part_compounds: Keep full span and its subword spans. Explicit forms semen/baca/radix/folia/vitella/capita/intestinas/fasciculus may receive PART_OR_PRESENTATION plus an explicitly written complement. Freeze alternatives for modifier sharing rather than inserting an omitted noun. Inventory category membership is distinct from botanical identity.
policy.state_participles: An adjectival/participial form can receive STATE, WRITTEN_OPERATION_PARTICIPLE, or BOTH as finite annotation alternatives. It does not insert a missing finite operation or time step. Finite verbs remain separately recorded literal forms.
policy.alternatives: Every written sive/vel/aut occurrence is retained. Operands may be smallest adjacent coordinated constituents or larger complete noun phrases; choose from explicitly delimited contiguous spans before a fit, or keep the parse alternatives. Never turn ordinary et into substitution OR.
policy.conditions: Retain exact si/cum/dum/mox/antequam/ut/relative clauses. Distinguish condition, temporal and purpose/complement as unresolved alternatives where necessary. No inferred ELSE or invented condition. A finite span lattice can enumerate observed punctuation/verb boundaries, but arbitrary large alternatives would weaken meaning constraints and are not independent semantic evidence.
policy.references: eius/suo/ipso/haec/eum and cross-block eo iure remain explicit unresolved reference tokens; possible written antecedent spans can be listed without forcing coreference.
policy.editorial: Bracketed [Si], [hec de patella], supplied angle-marked material and malformed tag recovery remain flagged. No printed-edition substitutions.
